steps.name: Login and open Sales Enquiry module
Create enquiry and save Acrylic product details
Create PPJO and submit Artwork, AutoCAD, Site Visit, Procurement, and Estimation requests
Return to Sales Enquiry and Validate Sales Enquiry status
Verify that the estimation request is displayed in the Estimation - Request (Normal) list
Verify generate cost estimation and validate request attachments
Verify that BOQ is created and BOQ details are generated successfully
Verify consumables, BOM, and BOL entries are added successfully
Verify BOQ summary is saved successfully with variation
Verify that packing cost is generated and packing BOM is added successfully
Verify that packing labour is added and the packing summary is saved successfully
Cost Distribution: Verify sample cost and cost distribution are saved successfully
Summary: Verify that the incentive summary is calculated and saved successfully
Price Indication Slip: Verify Price Indication Slip is saved and Version 1 is submitted for approval successfully
Verify estimation status in Request Normal is updated to Pending For Approval after submission
Verify that the cost estimation is approved and submitted to Sales successfully with Approved status reflected in history
Verify that the Sales Enquiry status moves to Quotation Pending and the quotation is generated and submitted for approval
Quotation Manager: Verify Quotation Manager approves the quotation and the Approved status is reflected
Quotation: Verify send quotation to customer and advance invoice request is submitted successfully
Invoice Request: Verify advance invoice is created from Invoice Request and the status is updated to Completed
Invoice Register: Verify Invoice Register is rejected by the Manager and acknowledged with the acknowledgement status updated to No
Verify Invoice Register is rejected by the Manager with status reflected in sales enquiry
